name: AWS CloudTrail Logging Stopped or Deleted
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
  eventSource="cloudtrail.amazonaws.com" eventName IN ("StopLogging", "DeleteTrail")
| stats count by host

name: AWS Console Multiple Failed Logins for One User
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
  eventSource="signin.amazonaws.com" eventName="ConsoleLogin"
  responseElements.ConsoleLogin="Failure"
| bin _time span=10m
  | stats count as event_count by _time userIdentity.userName, host
| where event_count > 5
| stats sum(event_count) as total_matches by host

name: AWS IAM AccessDenied Burst From One Principal
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
  errorCode="AccessDenied"
| bin _time span=15m
  | stats dc(eventName) as value_count by _time userIdentity.arn, host
| where value_count > 20
| stats sum(value_count) as total_matches by host

name: AWS IAM Policy Deleted
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
  eventSource="iam.amazonaws.com" eventName="DeletePolicy"
| stats count by host

name: AWS New Virtual MFA Device Registered
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
  eventSource="iam.amazonaws.com" eventName IN ("CreateVirtualMFADevice", "EnableMFADevice")
| stats count by host

name: AWS S3 Bucket ACL Granted to AuthenticatedUsers or AllUsers
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
  "groups/global/AuthenticatedUsers" OR "groups/global/AllUsers"
  eventSource="s3.amazonaws.com" eventName="PutBucketAcl"
| stats count by host

name: Azure AD Multiple Denied MFA Requests for One User
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad"
  operationName="Sign-in activity" resultType="500121"
| bin _time span=10m
  | stats count as event_count by _time identity, host
| where event_count > 3
| stats sum(event_count) as total_matches by host

name: Azure AD Distributed Password Spray
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad"
  operationName="Sign-in activity" resultType="50126"
| bin _time span=10m
  | stats dc(identity) as value_count by _time callerIpAddress, host
| where value_count > 5
| stats sum(value_count) as total_matches by host

name: Azure AD Privileged Directory Role Assigned
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="azure:monitor:aad"
  operationName="Add member to role"
  properties.targetResources{}.modifiedProperties{}.newValue IN
    ("*Global Administrator*", "*Privileged Role Administrator*", "*Privileged Authentication Administrator*")
| stats count by host

name: O365 Exchange Management Role Assigned
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="o365:management:activity"
  Operation="New-ManagementRoleAssignment"
| stats count by host

name: O365 Mailbox Forwarding Rule or Forwarding Address Set
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="o365:management:activity"
  Operation IN ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Set-Mailbox")
  Parameters{}.Name IN ("ForwardTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardingAddress", "ForwardingSmtpAddress")
| stats count by host

name: O365 Service Principal or Credential Added
scoring_search:
index=cloud_lab sourcetype="o365:management:activity"
  Operation="Add service principal*"
| stats count by host
